messages:
mira: Hey team — customer (FinArc) wants a 2-week POC connecting their on-prem app to Redwood Private in their VPC. Need a simple network plan + list of blockers.
arjun: @mira quick q — did they explicitly rule out VPC peering? PrivateLink typically cleaner for cross-account isolation.
sam: They said no peering for compliance reasons, so plan is PrivateLink (interface endpoint) + egress proxy from our side if needed.
mira: Correct, they want no peering. Also they asked about preserving client IPs for logs.
arjun: Preserving source IPs with PrivateLink requires us to avoid SNAT on the egress path; that usually means BYOIP or a passthrough proxy. Not default for hosted.
emma: Security questionnaire items: they want KMS key ownership, rotation cadence, audit log retention (13 months), and evidence of pen test. Can we confirm?
arjun: For Redwood Private (on-prem/VPC) we support customer-managed KMS keys. For hosted, we manage keys but can provide rotation policy docs and CloudTrail/flow logs export.
sam: Network firewall snippet — here's a minimal example they can drop into their FW team: 
```
# Allow egress to Redwood Private (interface endpoint)
ALLOW tcp 443 from on-prem-subnet/24 to <redwood-endpoint-ENI>
ALLOW udp 123 from on-prem-subnet/32 to ntp.pool.org
# Deny all other outbound to unapproved ranges
DENY all from on-prem to 0.0.0.0/0 except above
```
mira: They also asked about MTU over IPsec. If they terminate IPsec to our TGW, MTU might need to be lowered to 1400 to avoid fragmentation.
emma: Pricing question from buyer: for the 2-week POC at ~100 RPS sustained, do we recommend Hosted burst or a small Dedicated commit?
sales_ops: @mira received. Ballpark: Hosted with burst likely cheaper for short POC (estimate ~$2k for 2 weeks at 100rps with caching). Dedicated monthly starts higher but gives guaranteed throughput; we can offer a trial credit for POC. Will confirm detailed numbers by EOD.
arjun: Also need their AWS account ID, VPC CIDR, preferred AZs, and whether they want us to create an endpoint service in our account or they will create endpoints pointing at our published service.
mira: I'll ask for account ID + CIDR + contact in netops. Also procurement requires SOC2 + export control clause before kickoff.
emma: I can assemble the security pack: SOC2 link, KMS policy summary, log retention statement, pen-test attestation. Need thumbs-up on hosted vs private from sales.
sam: Enterprise blocker flagged: their legal insists on a local on-prem deployment option for certain workloads (air-gapped). That will push timeline — legal + eng to review on-prem installer licensing.
mira: Ok — schedule netops handoff call Thu 10am PT. Please add legal and security.
arjun: I'll join Thu and bring network checklist. I'll draft the endpoint / route table steps beforehand.
emra: (typo) meant to say: will share route table example.
emma: Minor note: if they use corporate TLS inspection, they must allow SNI passthrough or proxy cert pinning will fail. Call that out.
sales_ops: Got the meeting. Sending SOC2 doc and rough cost via DM to @mira.
mira: Thanks all — next steps: 1) netops call Thu 10am PT, 2) sales_ops estimate, 3) security pack upload, 4) legal review on on-prem option. :thumbsup:
